tue-dinner-honey-lemon-chicken.title: Honey, lemon & garlic chicken rice bowls with spinach, tomato, lettuce & tahini-yogurt sauce
method: Cook the rice and divide it across five portions.
Mix honey, mustard, zest and juice of half the lemon, crushed garlic and olive oil. Coat the chicken and cook in a hot pan until well browned and cooked through.
Wilt the spinach briefly. Chop the tomatoes, lettuce and red onion for a fresh salad.
Loosen yogurt and tahini with the remaining lemon juice and a little water.
Build every bowl with rice, chicken, spinach, salad and tahini-yogurt sauce. Box two complete adult portions before serving.
tue-dinner-honey-lemon-chicken.flavourNote: Brown the chicken properly so the honey caramelises; the lemon and mustard should keep the glaze sharp rather than sweet, while tahini-yogurt adds richness.
tue-dinner-honey-lemon-chicken.barneyNote: Keep his chicken lightly seasoned, cut small, and serve salad components in manageable pieces.
tue-dinner-honey-lemon-chicken.storageNote: Chill the two complete Wednesday lunch bowls promptly; reheat chicken, rice and spinach until piping hot and add cold salad/sauce after heating.

wed-dinner-beef-rigatoni.title: Beef, courgette & carrot rigatoni in rich tomato-basil sauce with Parmesan
method: Cook the rigatoni 1–2 minutes short of the packet time.
Brown the beef mince hard in olive oil. Add diced onion, grated carrot and diced courgette; cook until softened and starting to colour.
Add garlic, both tins of chopped tomatoes and the chopped fresh tomato. Simmer uncovered for 15–20 minutes until thick and rich.
Stir through most of the basil and half the Parmesan, then combine with the rigatoni. Finish with the remaining Parmesan and basil.
Box two complete adult portions before serving.
wed-dinner-beef-rigatoni.flavourNote: The key is deep browning on the beef and a properly reduced tomato sauce; Parmesan and basil provide umami and freshness rather than relying on sweetness.
wed-dinner-beef-rigatoni.barneyNote: Remove his portion before extra salt and pepper; grate the vegetables finely and cut pasta if needed.
wed-dinner-beef-rigatoni.storageNote: Cool and chill two complete portions promptly; reheat once until piping hot.

thu-dinner-sticky-pork-noodles.title: Sticky ginger pork & vegetable noodles with pak choi, red pepper and spring onion
method: Brown the pork mince over high heat until it develops crisp edges rather than steaming.
Add finely chopped ginger, garlic and sliced red pepper; stir-fry for 2–3 minutes.
Add the pak choi and noodles, then toss with soy sauce, honey and sesame oil until glossy and hot.
Finish with lime juice and sliced spring onion. Taste the adults' portions for soy/lime balance.
Box two complete noodle portions for Friday lunch.
thu-dinner-sticky-pork-noodles.flavourNote: The pork should be deeply browned; soy gives savoury depth, honey just enough gloss, and lime keeps the sauce bright rather than cloying.
thu-dinner-sticky-pork-noodles.storageNote: Cool two complete portions quickly and refrigerate; reheat thoroughly on Friday.

fri-dinner-ginger-coconut-chicken.title: Ginger coconut chicken curry with broccoli, red pepper & rice
method: Cook the rice.
Soften the onion, ginger and garlic, then add 1 tbsp curry paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add chicken, coconut milk, broccoli and red pepper. Simmer gently until the chicken is cooked and vegetables are tender.
Remove Barney's portion before increasing the adults' sauce with the remaining 2 tbsp curry paste and soy sauce.
Finish the adult curry with lime juice and serve with rice.
fri-dinner-ginger-coconut-chicken.flavourNote: Frying the curry paste first and finishing with soy and lime gives the sauce depth, salt and acidity so it does not taste flat.
fri-dinner-ginger-coconut-chicken.barneyNote: His portion is removed before the extra curry paste and soy; cut chicken and broccoli appropriately and serve with plenty of rice.
fri-dinner-ginger-coconut-chicken.storageNote: Refrigerate any unserved food within 2 hours.
